LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_TAX_OFFICE: It is a good strategy to build multiple Tax Offices around large villages.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_TAX_TRACKER: Right-click on {1} to toggle the Taxation Tracker.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_BUILDER_WORKSHOP_CL: Place Builder's Workshops close to large constructions for better efficiency.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_PLAN_DESIRABILITY: Plan desirable housing in advance before promoting villagers.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_NEED_PROXY: Villagers fulfil needs located close to their housing.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_STATUS_PRODUCTIVITY: Some workplaces gain increased productivity when employing villagers of higher status.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_TOOL_INVESTMENT: Producing {1} Tools early on is a valuable investment.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_TREASURY_LIMIT: Coin revenues, including quest rewards, are limited by your Treasury capacity.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_MONASTIC_WORK: Monastics work exclusively in their assigned Monastery.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_STORAGE_EFFICIENCY: Build storage buildings near workplaces and markets for efficient resource distribution.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_HAPPY_COMBATANT: A happy, well-trained, and well-armed Combatant is a lasting one.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_TOWER_FORTIFICATION: Towers from the Manor House, Churches, and the Castle provide Passive Fortification.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_MONASTERY_AUTONOMOU: Monasteries are autonomous; they automatically assign workers to their workplaces.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_BUILDING_BORDER: When placing buildings, pay attention to the blue borders and entrance arrows as they determine villagers' movement.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_PATH_DECAY: Unused Dirt Paths decay over time. Stone Roads don't decay so long as Paviours maintain them with {1} Stone.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_LEVY_EMERGENCY: Use the Levy Mandate from the Great Hall if you need emergency funds.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_RESOURCE_TRACKER: Right-click on resources displayed on the HUD to toggle their {1} Tracker.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_PROMOTE_VILLAGERS: Promoting villagers is key to prosperity; make sure to fulfil their new needs.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_VISIT_HELP: Learn more about the game by visiting the {1} Help Panel at the top-left corner of your screen!
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_CLOSE_WINDOWS: Right-clicking lets you close windows faster.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_VISIBILITY_PANEL: Toggle the display of village information using the {1} Visibility Panel.
LOADING_TIPS.LOADING_TIP_PRIORITY_COMMON_DECORATIONS: Common Decorations yield {1}{2}{3} Splendour or {4} Beautification, depending on whether they are part of a Monument.
